title: Clearance
units: CSS px, physical, relative to the container border box; box is getBoundingClientRect (the border box); lines are unions of Ahem glyph rects per block container

c-none.note: left 50x30 and right 60x50, then a 10px block with clear:none

c-left.note: left 50x30 and right 60x50, then a 10px block with clear:left

c-right.note: left 50x30 and right 60x50, then a 10px block with clear:right

c-both.note: left 50x30 and right 60x50, then a 10px block with clear:both

c-inline-start.note: left 50x30 and right 60x50, then a 10px block with clear:inline-start

c-inline-end.note: left 50x30 and right 60x50, then a 10px block with clear:inline-end

c-text-left.note: left 50x30 and right 60x50, then an auto-height block of text with clear:left

c-text-right.note: left 50x30 and right 60x50, then an auto-height block of text with clear:right

c-text-both.note: left 50x30 and right 60x50, then an auto-height block of text with clear:both

c-text-inline-start.note: left 50x30 and right 60x50, then an auto-height block of text with clear:inline-start

c-text-inline-end.note: left 50x30 and right 60x50, then an auto-height block of text with clear:inline-end

c-margin-less.note: cleared block with margin-block-start 10 < float height 30: clearance

c-margin-more.note: cleared block with margin-block-start 50 > float height 30: no clearance

c-margin-equal.note: cleared block with margin-block-start exactly the float height

c-prev-margin.note: block with margin-block-end 20, float 40, cleared block with margin-block-start 10

c-prev-margin-big.note: block with margin-block-end 40, float 10, cleared block: the hypothetical position is already past the float

c-negative-clearance.note: block margin-block-end 30, float 10, cleared block margin-block-start 30

c-after-margin.note: cleared block with margin-block-end 15 followed by a block

c-nested.note: clear on a grandchild whose parent has no border: clearance applies through margin collapsing

c-nested-border.note: clear on a grandchild inside a bordered parent

c-self-collapsing.note: empty block with clear:both, then text

c-self-collapsing-margins.note: empty block with clear:left and margins 5/7, then a block with margin-block-start 3

c-br-all.note: <br clear=all> in text beside two floats

c-float-in-sibling-bfc.note: a float inside a sibling flow-root does not affect clear outside it

c-float-in-child.note: a float inside a normal child still affects a later cleared sibling

c-fractional-margin.note: float 17.7px after a 5.2px block, cleared block with margin 3.3

c-neg-margin-float.note: float with margin-block-end -10: clearance uses the margin box bottom

c-computed.note: computed clear of a float, an inline span and an abspos box
